title: Raptors rookie Allen Graves making first career start vs. Pistons
text:
Raptors rookie Allen Graves making first career start vs. Pistons - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Raptors rookie Allen Graves making first career start vs. Pistons
 Sportsnet Staff @Sportsnet November 20, 2026 - 7:17pm Toronto Raptors forward Allen Graves inbounds the ball during the second half of an NBA basketball game against the Minnesota Timberwolves, Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026, in Minneapolis. (AP Photo/Bailey Hillesheim) 
 Thanks to some injury trouble, Allen Graves is getting a big opportunity early in his NBA career.
 The Toronto Raptors rookie will make his first career start on Friday against the Detroit Pistons. 
 Graves has appeared in all 15 of the Raptors' games this season, playing 14.9 minutes per contest. He's averaging 4.6 points and 2.8 rebounds on 41.9 per cent shooting. 
 The Santa Clara product will start alongside Scottie Barnes, Immanuel Quickley, Ja'Kobe Walter and Jakob Poeltl. This new-look starting five is due to Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett and Collin Murray-Boyles all being sidelined. 
 Graves was selected 19th overall by the Raptors in the 2026 NBA draft.
